observations: A head-shaped form fills most of the white canvas, built entirely from overlapping straight and angled lines in red, yellow, black, teal, green, and gray, with no solid color fills anywhere.
Two thick black cross marks occupy the eye positions, each centered inside a densely layered rectangular zone of yellow and red lines.
The upper edge breaks into loose upward strokes in teal and yellow, while the lower jaw area opens into closely spaced vertical black lines.
reading: The form holds together as a head only through the accumulated pressure of crossed and stacked lines—nothing is filled solid. Red loops and yellow diagonals compete for the same zones, keeping the surface restless rather than resolved. The two black cross marks read as blunt placeholders rather than eyes, giving the face structure a flat, locked quality. The open white ground makes every line visible as a mark, not a boundary.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nifty faces #20 and nnxyz nifty faces #22, which also align as recorded-creation neighbors. Unlike #20's hot-pink border and tilted composition, or #22's purple field and looping black lines, #21 works on bare white with a more angular, grid-like line structure.

connections.reason: Both works use yellow as a dominant structural color layered under red lines to define a head form, but #20 tilts its composition inside a bold pink border while #21 sits upright on open white—a direct contrast in framing and orientation.

nnotb #7 also places prominent cross marks inside eye-like zones on a face-shaped form, making the cross-as-eye placement a visible point of comparison across two different owned series by the same artist.
